title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt CI hooks + quality gating for prompt-set regressions
author: Ava Patel
summary_commits: c1a2f3d: Add per-prompt threshold config and gating enforcement in eval-harness
d4b5e6f: Wire CI hooks into GitHub Actions + add smoke tests for prompt regressions
e7f8a9b: Docs: document per-prompt thresholds and how CI gates operate
description:
Context:
As model updates and runtime changes accumulate we were seeing noisy regressions flagged only at aggregate eval levels. Teams asked for per-prompt gating so a single failing prompt (e.g. hallucination or formatting regression) can block a rollout while providing clear failure signals. This PR introduces per-prompt threshold configuration, integrates gating check as a CI hook, and wires metrics so alerts and dashboards can reference the gated prompts.

Motivation and goals:
- Add the ability to declare per-prompt quality thresholds (metric + delta) in the eval-harness config.
- Run a lightweight prompt-set regression check in PR CI (fast path) that fails fast on critical regressions.
- Surface metrics to the existing eval metrics pipeline for historical tracking and alerting.
- Provide docs and examples so platform and product teams can adopt prompt gating for their rollouts.

What changed (high level):
- eval-harness/prompt_checks/per_prompt_thresholds.py: new module that parses per-prompt rules and evaluates metric deltas against CI-safe thresholds. Includes a small translator from internal metrics to the gating API.
- eval-harness/ci/prompt-gate-action.yml: new GitHub Action that runs the harness in a fast-check mode with sampled prompts and short-circuit failure on critical regressions.
- eval-harness/metrics/integration_adapter.py: hooks to ensure gated prompt metrics are emitted with stable tags so the monitoring pipeline can ingest them.
- Tests: added test_prompt_gating.py covering pass/fail/edge cases and a fixture prompt set.
- Docs: prompt-gating.md + examples in quickstarts and redwood-docs.
- CI glue: small shell helpers to run the harness in the monorepo CI.

Checklist:
- [x] Per-prompt threshold config format (defaults.yaml updated)
- [x] CI action implemented and syntax validated
- [x] Unit tests added and passing locally
- [x] Metrics tags added and backward-compatible
- [x] Docs and example updated
- [x] Non-blocking: dashboard JSON added for visibility

Review and CI history (short):
- Initial push (c1a2f3d) added the gating logic and CI action. CI failed on lint/formatting and a flaky test. Commented by Lena Kim requesting clearer errors when a prompt threshold is missing.
- Addressed missing-threshold handling (d4b5e6f). Diego asked for metrics tag normalization and adding a smoke test; added in the same commit.
- CI rerun failed once due to a transient network in a downstream metrics adapter; retried and passed. Final CI status: pass.

Reviewers' notes and convo summary:
- Lena Kim: "This looks good — please expose a clear error message when a threshold isn't configured and add a small note in the docs about when teams should opt-in vs using global thresholds."
- Author (Ava): "Added explicit missing-threshold error and a toggle (fast_check_only) to keep initial runs conservative. Docs updated with examples and recommended default delta values."
- Marco Sanchez: "Approved after nits — mainly test names and a small shell safety check in run-eval-harness.sh."
- Diego Ramos: "Added suggestion to normalize metric tags for ingestion; addressed in integration_adapter.py."

Testing notes:
- Unit tests: eval-harness/tests/test_prompt_gating.py (covers threshold boundary, missing threshold, metric delta handling).
- CI: GitHub Actions workflow runs the new prompt-gate-action with a fast-check flag on PRs against main. On successful merge, a nightly job runs the full prompt-set CI as a scheduled check.

Operational notes and rollout plan:
- The feature is behind a config toggle (prompt_gating.enabled) defaulting to false to avoid accidental blocking. The GitHub Action will opt into repo-level config for early adopters.
- Platform teams should add a per-repo defaults.yaml with per-prompt thresholds for critical prompt sets.
- Monitoring: new metric tags added; dashboards updated (monitoring/dashboards/eval-prompt-regressions.json) to let SREs and model owners track gating failures over time.

Release notes:
- Added per-prompt CI gating to eval-harness. Teams can opt-in to block PRs on prompt-level regressions. See eval-harness/docs/prompt-gating.md for configuration and examples.

Merge outcome:
- PR was merged to main via squash on 2024-11-02 after approvals from Lena Kim, Marco Sanchez, and Diego Ramos. CI green at merge time.

Follow-ups (future work):
- Expand gating to support multi-metric composite rules (quality + latency) — follow-up ENG-4890.
- Add a UI in Redwood Console to let teams mark prompt-criticality and view failing prompts directly from a rollout page.

Contact: ava.patel@redwood.ai for rollout questions and coordination.

example_commands:
# Run fast prompt gate locally
python -m eval_harness.prompt_checks.per_prompt_thresholds --config eval-harness/config/defaults.yaml --fast-check
# CI action is eval-harness/ci/prompt-gate-action.yml and will be triggered on PRs when repo config opts in
